projects.title: rymo
projects.description: Engineered a local-first knowledge canvas inspired by Miro, supporting Kanban boards, Markdown, freehand drawing, PDF editing, notes, links, and more. Created a portable JSON-based board format with a custom encoder and decoder for data integrity and long-term interoperability. Built a mobile companion application that brings drawing and core workspace features to handheld devices, using the desktop app as the source of truth for secure real-time synchronization.

projects.title: Hack The Change 2024 | 2nd Place
projects.description: Shipped an LLM-powered mental-health game that classified journal entries by tone and theme, placing 2nd among 50+ teams. Built an LLM-powered content moderation pipeline to classify and filter harmful user-generated content.

experiences.description: Architected and shipped a full-stack CRM and retail operations platform using React, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL for 8 retail locations. Integrated Dutchie, KayaPush, Resend, and Blackleaf, reconciling 500K+ customer records and 900K+ transaction line items. Built C-suite analytics dashboards and platform-wide RBAC, enforcing scoped access across CRM, analytics, campaigns, and operations. Designed, provisioned, and configured a Linux VPS infrastructure stack, deploying Dockerized services including Nginx, Authentik, Nextcloud, Stalwart, Portainer, and other internal systems.

Built a JavaScript rule sandbox that replaced a manual workflow, saving 8 staff hours/week. Shipped 10+ production full-stack features in C#/.NET and React across a DDD-based microservice architecture. Built a Python + LLM rules knowledge base for internal teams and client-facing documentation, accelerating rule development 5x. Delivered 30+ production insurance rules in JavaScript, reducing average implementation time by 50%.

Architected Kotlin mobile GUI and core application logic to create smoother, more responsive user interactions, and developed a Node.js service that coordinated WebRTC signaling for reliable, low-latency peer-to-peer communication.
